typography.heading: Cormorant Garamond, serif
typography.notes: No Inter, no Space Grotesk. High-contrast editorial serif for display, warm grotesque for body.

textures_and_effects.global_grain: SVG noise filter overlaid globally with mix-blend-mode at 4% opacity.
textures_and_effects.hero_grain: 7% SVG noise opacity in hero section + scanline pattern texture overlay.
textures_and_effects.shadows: NO colored box-shadows. Depth achieved via borders, opacity, and parallax.
textures_and_effects.borders: 1px outlines, amber halos. Monospace pills have 1px amber border and faint amber bg (rgba(196, 154, 60, 0.05)).
textures_and_effects.blur: Progressive global backdrop-blur as user scrolls past 80% of page height.

motion.fade_up: whileInView { y: 24, opacity: 0 } -> { y: 0, opacity: 1 }, transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }

copy_tone.style: Novelist-who-ships-software. Short sentences. No bullets. No exclamation marks.

sections.name: Atmospheric Loader
sections.details: Single pulsing amber dot (#C49A3C) in center of dark screen. Max 1.2s duration. Full page fade-in afterwards. No progress bar.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Full-viewport height. Giant 'SERVE' serif wordmark (near-black #111012 on near-black #0C0C0D background) revealed by a slow vertical light-sweep mask animation. Monospace subline 'not a tool. a room.' appearing letter-by-letter below. Drifting amber gradient orb (off-center bottom-left, absolute positioned, animating 6px upward in a 12s loop). Late-fade navbar appearing 0.8s after load. Scroll indicator: thin vertical line + chevron at bottom center fading in at 2s.

sections.name: Editorial Manifesto
sections.details: 60/40 split layout. Large italic pull-quote on left (sliding in from left-margin). Rotated 90-degree watermark text 'UTILITY VS. PRESENCE' anchored to the right side.

sections.name: The Room
sections.details: Core concept section. Serif headline. Triptych of words: 'Somber.', 'Warm.', 'Dark.' rendered in amber-gold, staggered entrance at 150ms each.

sections.name: Feature Trio
sections.details: Three stacked horizontal rows. Each row contains a monospace number label, sharp copy, and a hand-coded abstract SVG glyph (Row 1: waveform, Row 2: node cluster, Row 3: spiral). Interaction: hover-lift effect on the row with the amber label glowing.

sections.name: Memory Ritual (Local-First)
sections.details: Full-width canvas layout. Floating amber-bordered quote fragments positioned abstractly. Connected by SVG thread lines using `stroke-dashoffset` driven by scroll progress. Implements parallax depth split: background 0.3x, mid-layer lines 0.6x, foreground quotes 1x.

sections.name: Open Source
sections.details: Card with 1px amber border. Fetches live GitHub star count client-side from api.github.com/repos/knightabdo/serve. Includes a ghost CTA 'View Source →'.

sections.name: Built By
sections.details: Minimalist block. 48px amber-ring avatar (use avatar_placeholder). '@jip7e' in monospace. X (Twitter) icon link. One-line bio: 'novelist who ships software.'

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Single centered line of text. Max grain intensity applied to background. E.g., '© 2026 SERVE. Local-first reflection.'

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
